note: Package 3b: the personal settings layer, the commit policy by environment, hooks that fire once, and the small items of docs/plan/package-3b.md. Contract: .claude/architecture/feature/engine-package-3b.md. One slice = one commit on unattended/2026-10-02-package-3b. S7-S9 are owner-only and parked from the start with their exact unblocking step.

nodes.title: personal-layer: user/settings.json, engine.py install --personal, the parity check, the proposed shared settings.json (tracer bullet)
nodes.evidence: user/settings.json holds defaultMode, 7 additionalDirectories, WebFetch/WebSearch, 4 model env vars; engine.py install --personal [--dry-run] [--home] merges it (set/append/keep, backup before write, refuses hooks); evals/settings_parity.py computes effective settings per the documented merge rules; docs/tasks/settings.json + README.md (apply command) + effective-before-split.json. test_personal_layer.py 29/29, test_settings_proposal.py 8/8; parity on the owner's real home file read-only: 13/13 identical. ruff + mypy --strict clean on the 4 Python files.

nodes.title: hooks-fire-once: the personal layer wires no hooks; an engine hook outside the project stands down when the project wires its own copy
nodes.evidence: engine_stand_down() in all 9 hooks (4 skill copies synced): static rule, STOOD_DOWN marker on stderr, exit 0; ENGINE_HOOK_ALWAYS_RUN=1 the only override. Runner executes <project_dir>/.claude/hooks/<hook> for subdirectory sessions and sets the override for --hooks-dir. test_hooks_fire_once.py 33/33; owner's real ~/.claude/settings.json read-only: no hooks key, so no duplicate today. Pre-existing ruff/mypy findings in the 4 Python hooks cleared (16).

nodes.title: commit-policy-by-environment: env-probe.sh, cloud commit switch (ships off), commit_checkpoint.sh keeps a suffixed branch and commits the index as staged
nodes.evidence: block-dangerous.sh: environment table in the header, cloud rule behind CLOUD_COMMIT_POLICY (project.env, ships off, read with sed); commit_checkpoint.sh keeps a suffixed unattended/* branch, --staged commits the index, mirrors the cloud rule; .claude/unattended/env-probe.sh prints the facts (names only for env vars, allow-listed values, masked remote URLs) and the policy's verdict here. test_commit_policy.py 20/20, test_commit_checkpoint.py 19/19, test_env_probe.py 15/15; 4 new scenarios (81 total).

install-name-collision: install.sh refuses a user skill named like an engine skill; the prefix for new personal skills

nodes.parked_on: The run may only dry-run against ~/.claude. Unblocks when the owner runs `python3 engine.py install --personal --ref unattended/2026-10-02-package-3b` after reading its --dry-run.

nodes.title: cloud-probe (OWNER): run .claude/unattended/env-probe.sh in a real cloud session, then decide CLOUD_COMMIT_POLICY
nodes.parked_on: Only a real cloud session can produce the facts. Unblocks when the owner pastes the probe's output back; the switch stays off until then.
